turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Sam Osei, thanks for having me out today to look at your electrical panel.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for coming, come on in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Have you looked at other options before reaching out to us?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We want something reliable that won't cost us more down the road.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Based on what we've walked through, the total price for this would be $6,800.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll need to talk to my spouse before we commit to anything.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I understand, it is an investment. We do have financing options if that helps.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Why don't I send over the paperwork and we can follow up in a few days?
